ideas.title: FBI Investigation into 2020 Election
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's investigation into the 2020 election, including the raids on election offices in Georgia and Atlanta.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and the trail of evidence
questions: What evidence does the FBI have of election fraud?
Who is behind the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread election fraud and abuse of power at the highest levels of government. Investigating the FBI's investigation could reveal a complex web of corruption and deceit.

ideas.title: ICE Agent Involved Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the shooting of Alex Pretti by an ICE agent and the subsequent investigation.
ideas.angle: Examine the use of force and accountability within ICE
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Has the ICE agent been held accountable?
ideas.insight: This story highlights the need for greater accountability and transparency within ICE. Investigating the shooting and the subsequent investigation could reveal a pattern of abuse of power and lack of accountability within the agency.
